IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. BOIDENT2.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-CAPITAL-PCT PIC 9(3)V99.
       01 WS-PROFIT-PCT PIC 9(3)V99.
       01 WS-CONTROL-IND PIC X.
       01 WS-IS-BO PIC X VALUE 'N'.

           ACCEPT WS-CAPITAL-PCT

              MOVE 'Y' TO WS-IS-BO
           END-IF
           DISPLAY 'BO: ' WS-IS-BO
           STOP RUN.
